_status: DRAFT proposal (not submitted, not certified). Needs a catalogue entry for nearesis_live.rt_minutes (ReplacingMergeTree, key minute) and a rolling-window time grain (`hour`), neither of which exists in the v1 MetricProposal contract (time grain is day|week|month). Submit only after the owner approves running the opt-in realtime feed continuously.
name: transactions_last_hour
description: Count of NEAR transactions included in final blocks during the most recent 60 complete UTC minutes, from the forward-only real-time feed. Only minutes whose blocks are all final and whose coverage is complete are summed; an open or partially covered minute is reported separately as provisional and never added.

tests.name: sum of minutes equals sum of rt_blocks.tx_count for the same minutes

limitations: Forward-only: no value exists for any window before the feed's first stored block.
Fewer than 60 complete final minutes means a lower bound; the API reports PARTIAL with missingMinutes, never a zero-filled total.
Real-time days are reconciled against the BigQuery daily total (near_daily_tx.tx_count); BigQuery stays authoritative and the live figure may be restated by that reconciliation.
Served today by GET /v1/realtime/transactions-last-hour; certification is blocked on the rolling-hour grain.
